# ExternalMomentum

Source: [`Kernel/ExternalMomentum.wl`](../../Kernel/ExternalMomentum.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#externalmomentum-kernelexternalmomentumwl--buildloequations)

BuildLOEquations: the LO pipeline (design/LOPIPELINE.md step 5). The Gamma2 couplings are a reference times a function F(p^2); the flow of each function is the one-loop d\_s Gamma2\_ab(nu = 0, p) at generic external momentum p, with the loop frequency integrated by residues over the two pole families Delta(w, q^2) and Delta(w, Q^2), Q = p + q. It replaces ProjectOnMonomials, IntegrateFrequencies, CheckClosure and AssembleEquations of the derivative expansion and returns an "Equations" stage with "Pipeline" -> "LO". Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "ExternalMomentum".

## Symbols

### `BuildLOEquations`

`BuildLOEquations[loops, symmetries]` builds the LO flow equations: for each function F of the ansatz (Gamma2\_ab(0, p) = norm ref p^(2n) F(p^2)) the integrand of d\_s(ref F(p^2)) = Integral d^dq/(2 Pi)^d Integrand(p, q, CosTheta), already divided by norm p^(2n), and the p -> 0 limit (integrand of d\_s ref, which fixes eta through F(0) = 1). Checks the zero entries at every p, the Protected i w entries at p = 0, the low orders below p^(2n), the angles and the shape derivatives. Returns the "Equations" stage with "Pipeline" -> "LO". Option "ExternalFrequency" -> True (NLO, design/NLOPIPELINE.md): the functions depend on (w, p) with w = Global\`w the external frequency; every function in the loop stays at zero frequency and w enters through G(omega + w, Q). A (I w)^0 function's Integrand is then the even part in w of d\_s Gamma2\_ab(w, p), a (I w)^1 function's the odd part divided by I w (exact, finite at w = 0); EtaIntegrand and every LO check stay at w = 0, and the stage gets "Approximation" -> "NLO" and "ExternalFrequency" -> w.

### `CosTheta`

CosTheta is the cosine of the angle between the external momentum p and the loop momentum q in LO integrands: p.q = p q CosTheta, Q^2 = p^2 + q^2 + 2 p q CosTheta.

### `ShowLOEquation`

`ShowLOEquation[equations, f]` prints the LO flow of the function f: prefactor, divided power of p^2, loop integrand and its p -> 0 limit.
